title: Merrily We Roll Along
songSummary: Practices listening memory, keyboard map and steady beat, with a tune you can share.

classes.title: Listen and sway
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and move to the beat
classes.parentTip: Sit together at the piano. Sway side to side while the song plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing the whole tune before playing it

classes.parentPrompt: Sit together at the piano. Sway side to side while the song plays.
classes.childAction: Sway and listen to the whole song.
classes.bridge: The keys light up where each sound lives.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced listening and remembering and keeping a steady beat.

classes.title: Find the beat
classes.goal: Tap a steady beat while the grown-up plays the tune
classes.parentTip: Any key is fine. Tap with your child's hand at first, then let go.

segments.caption: Tap any key on the beat
segments.parentCue: You play the tune, your child taps the beat

segments.caption: Tap, tap, tap, like a heartbeat
Play it together
segments.parentCue: Your child plays the special note

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling something that repeats at an even time

classes.parentPrompt: Any key is fine. Tap with your child's hand at first, then let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on every beat.
classes.bridge: The beat is a heartbeat: tap, tap, tap, never in a hurry.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced keeping a steady beat and playing together.

classes.title: Find the special note
classes.goal: Find and play the song's special note: E
classes.parentTip: Help your child find E. Use one finger and press gently, like a button.

segments.caption: It comes back again and again
segments.parentCue: Count how often you hear it

segments.caption: Your turn!
segments.parentCue: Help one finger press the key

segments.caption: Can you do it once more?

mathTarget.parentLine: Matching one sound to one key

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find E. Use one finger and press gently, like a button.
classes.childAction: Find the special note and play it on cue.
classes.bridge: The special note is a doorbell: same key, same sound, every time.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced finding the way on the keys and listening and remembering.

classes.title: E up high
classes.goal: Find the special note in a second place on the piano
classes.parentTip: Notes repeat every eight white keys. Let your child hop between the two Es.

segments.caption: E lives up high too!
segments.parentCue: Find the same key up high

mathTarget.parentLine: Finding the same note higher or lower on the keyboard

classes.parentPrompt: Notes repeat every eight white keys. Let your child hop between the two Es.
classes.childAction: Play the same note in its high and low homes.
classes.bridge: Every note has a family: same name, a different house.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced finding the way on the keys and hearing high and low.

classes.title: Special note in the song
classes.goal: Play the special note at the right moments in the song
classes.parentTip: You play the blue keys, your child plays the coral one. Waiting is part of the game.

segments.caption: Merrily We Roll Along
segments.subcaption: Class 7: Special note in the song

segments.caption: Now the special note in the song
When E lights up, it's your turn
segments.parentCue: Your child plays only the coral key

segments.caption: The whole song now

segments.caption: Play it together

classes.title: Add a second note
classes.goal: Play two special notes, E and D, in the song
classes.parentTip: Two notes means more waiting and watching. Celebrate each coral key your child catches.

segments.caption: A second special note: D
segments.parentCue: Your child now plays E and D

segments.caption: The whole song now
segments.parentCue: Two coral keys for your child

mathTarget.parentLine: Telling two sounds apart and matching each to its key

classes.parentPrompt: Two notes means more waiting and watching. Celebrate each coral key your child catches.
classes.childAction: Play the two special notes when they come.
classes.bridge: Two doorbells: one for each friend at the door.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced listening and remembering and finding the way on the keys.

classes.title: Play together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together at full speed
classes.parentTip: Keep playing even if your child misses a note. The beat matters more than being perfect.

segments.parentCue: You on the tune, your child on E

classes.title: Concert time
classes.goal: Play the whole song from start to end and celebrate
classes.parentTip: Clap, cheer and bow together. Mistakes are fine. The fun is playing to someone.
